import subprocess

result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', '''
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import TocExtension, render_inner_html, striptags
import html as html_mod

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=[TocExtension(anchorlink=True)])
text = "# This is `code` and `this` too."
md.convert(text)

# Find h1 element
for el in md.parser.root.iter():
    if el.tag == "h1":
        inner = render_inner_html(md, el)
        print(f"inner_html: {repr(inner)}")
        
        stripped = striptags(inner)
        print(f"stripped: {repr(stripped)}")
        
        unescaped = html_mod.unescape(stripped)
        print(f"unescaped: {repr(unescaped)}")
        
        from markdown.extensions.toc import slugify
        slug = slugify(unescaped, "-")
        print(f"slug: {repr(slug)}")
        break
'''], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
if result.returncode != 0:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr)
